# Parameter Specification: O-simpleWavetable

**CRITICAL CONTRACT:** This specification is immutable during implementation.

**Generated by:** UI mockup finalization (ui-mockup skill, v1)
**Generated date:** 2026-10-05
**Sources:** `research/ARCHITECTURE.md` §Parameter Mapping (authoritative values), `mockups/v1-ui.yaml` (UI controls), `parameter-spec-draft.md` (validated: same 21 IDs, no conflict)

## Total Parameter Count

**Total:** 21 parameters — 13 Float, 6 Choice, 2 Bool

> **Count correction.** ARCHITECTURE.md, the draft and ROADMAP.md all say "22 parameters", but every one of them lists the same **21** IDs (the brief's 20 rows + `lfo_div`); the draft's own summary also miscounts the floats as 14 (it is 13). No parameter is missing — the number was an arithmetic slip. Stage 1's `jassert (params.size() == 22)` in ROADMAP.md must be **21**.

All skews are `juce::NormalisableRange<float> { start, end, interval, skew }` with interval 0 (continuous) unless a step is listed. **Every range is a plain `NormalisableRange` with a skew factor — never a lambda-defined range** (the WebView slider frontend cannot see a lambda range; project memory `critical_lambda_normalisable_range_invisible_to_webview_slider_frontend`). The page carries no range numbers: readouts come from `getScaledValue()` and knob angles from `getNormalisedValue()`.

## Parameter Definitions

### bank
- **Type:** Choice (`AudioParameterChoice`)
- **Choices:** `Sine → Saw`, `Sine → Square`, `Pulse Width`, `Formant`, `Drive`, `Imported` (in this order; Imported is LAST — the UI never hard-codes its index, it reads `imported` from `bankUpdate`)
- **Default:** Sine → Saw (index 0)
- **UI Control:** `<select id="combo-bank">` in the header, options built from `properties.choices` (the option strings stay English — they are also the host automation names)
- **DSP Usage:** Selects the frame bank the oscillator reads. Five banks are generated from formulas at load (ARCHITECTURE §A3–A7, 32 × 2048 each); Imported reads the user's sliced audio (≤ 256 × 2048). Imported with nothing imported = silence + the UI's empty prompt. Bank changes go through the frozen-cycle crossfade (5 ms).

### position
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0, displayed 0.0–100.0 %
- **Default:** 0.0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Hero rotary knob (92 px, Oscillator group); also driven by vertical drag / wheel on the Bank Stack panel (same relay, bracketed gestures)
- **DSP Usage:** Scan position, frame 1 → frame N. 20 ms `SmoothedValue`; per-voice 2 ms one-pole when Interpolation is On. Effective position = clamp(position + depth·0.5·lfo + env_amount·modEnv, 0, 1).

### interp
- **Type:** Bool
- **Range:** Off / On
- **Default:** On (true)
- **UI Control:** Off | On segment pair (Oscillator group)
- **DSP Usage:** Frame-to-frame only. On: crossfade the two neighbouring frames. Off: latch the nearest frame at each cycle wrap (stepped PPG scan).

### bandlimit
- **Type:** Bool
- **Range:** Off / On
- **Default:** On (true)
- **UI Control:** Off | On segment pair (Oscillator group)
- **DSP Usage:** On: strict per-octave mip level `L = ceil(log2(f·2048/fs))`, Kmax = min(1023, 1024 >> L). Off: level 0 at every pitch (intended aliasing, the lesson).

### bit_depth
- **Type:** Choice
- **Choices:** `Full`, `16`, `15`, `14`, `13`, `12`, `11`, `10`, `9`, `8`, `7`, `6`, `5`, `4`, `3`
- **Default:** Full (index 0)
- **UI Control:** Stepped Family A knob (44 px) with 15 detent pips; readout "Full" / "N bit"
- **DSP Usage:** Mid-rise quantizer after frame interpolation and crossfade, before the amp envelope. bits = 17 − index; Full = bypass (bit-identical).

### lfo_rate
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.01 to 20.0 Hz
- **Default:** 0.5
- **Skew Factor:** 0.3 (`NormalisableRange { 0.01f, 20.0f, 0.0f, 0.3f }`, sibling)
- **UI Control:** Knob (54 px), visible when `lfo_sync` = Free
- **DSP Usage:** Free-running global LFO rate → Position.

### lfo_sync
- **Type:** Choice
- **Choices:** `Free`, `Tempo`
- **Default:** Free (index 0)
- **UI Control:** Free | Tempo segment pair; swaps the Rate knob for the Division knob in one slot
- **DSP Usage:** Free = `lfo_rate` in Hz; Tempo = `lfo_div` locked to the host PPQ (BPM fallback 120).

### lfo_div
- **Type:** Choice
- **Choices:** `4 bars`, `2 bars`, `1/1`, `1/2`, `1/4`, `1/8`, `1/16`, `1/32`, `1/2.`, `1/4.`, `1/8.`, `1/16.`, `1/2T`, `1/4T`, `1/8T`, `1/16T`
- **Beats per cycle:** 16, 8, 4, 2, 1, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 3, 1.5, 0.75, 0.375, 4/3, 2/3, 1/3, 1/6
- **Default:** 1/1 (index 2) — changed from the draft's 1/4: a 1/4-note sweep at 120 BPM is 2 Hz, too fast for a teaching scan
- **UI Control:** Stepped Family A knob (54 px, 16 pips) in the Rate slot, visible when `lfo_sync` = Tempo; readout = the choice string
- **DSP Usage:** Tempo-synced LFO period.

### lfo_shape
- **Type:** Choice
- **Choices:** `Sine`, `Triangle`, `Saw`, `Square`, `S&H`
- **Default:** Triangle (index 1)
- **UI Control:** Five icon segments (inline SVG glyphs, localized aria names)
- **DSP Usage:** Global LFO waveform; S&H uses a deterministic RNG, new value per LFO cycle.

### lfo_depth
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0, displayed 0–100 %
- **Default:** 0.0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Knob (54 px); also gates the LFO lamp
- **DSP Usage:** Contribution to Position = depth · 0.5 · lfo (bipolar around the knob).

### menv_attack
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.001 to 10.0 s
- **Default:** 0.5
- **Skew Factor:** 0.3
- **UI Control:** Small knob (44 px), Mod Envelope row
- **DSP Usage:** Per-voice modulation ADSR attack (→ Position via `env_amount`). Dirty-checked `setParameters`.

### menv_decay
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.001 to 10.0 s
- **Default:** 1.0
- **Skew Factor:** 0.3
- **UI Control:** Small knob (44 px)
- **DSP Usage:** Mod ADSR decay.

### menv_sustain
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0, displayed 0–100 %
- **Default:** 0.0
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Small knob (44 px)
- **DSP Usage:** Mod ADSR sustain level.

### menv_release
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.001 to 10.0 s
- **Default:** 0.5
- **Skew Factor:** 0.3
- **UI Control:** Small knob (44 px)
- **DSP Usage:** Mod ADSR release. A long mod release does not keep a voice alive (the amp envelope decides).

### env_amount
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** −1.0 to +1.0, displayed −100 % … +100 %
- **Default:** 0.0
- **Skew Factor:** linear (bipolar)
- **UI Control:** Bipolar knob (54 px) with a centre mark; drag snaps to the scaled value 0 within ±1.8 % of travel
- **DSP Usage:** Scales the mod envelope's contribution to Position; positive scans toward the back of the bank.

### amp_attack
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.001 to 5.0 s
- **Default:** 0.005
- **Skew Factor:** 0.35 (sibling)
- **UI Control:** Small knob (44 px), Amp Envelope row
- **DSP Usage:** Per-voice amp ADSR attack.

### amp_decay
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.001 to 5.0 s
- **Default:** 0.3
- **Skew Factor:** 0.35
- **UI Control:** Small knob (44 px)
- **DSP Usage:** Amp ADSR decay.

### amp_sustain
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0, displayed 0–100 %
- **Default:** 0.8
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Small knob (44 px)
- **DSP Usage:** Amp ADSR sustain level.

### amp_release
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.001 to 5.0 s
- **Default:** 0.2
- **Skew Factor:** 0.35
- **UI Control:** Small knob (44 px)
- **DSP Usage:** Amp ADSR release.

### voice_mode
- **Type:** Choice
- **Choices:** `Poly`, `Mono`
- **Default:** Poly (index 0)
- **UI Control:** Poly | Mono segment pair (Amp + Output group)
- **DSP Usage:** Poly = 16 voices; Mono = last-note priority, retrigger, no glide (Subtractive `renderMonoLegato` pattern).

### output_level
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** −60.0 to +6.0 dB
- **Default:** −6.0
- **Skew Factor:** linear, interval 0.1
- **Text:** `"-inf"` at ≤ −60 dB (parameter text function, and the UI readout at the range floor)
- **UI Control:** Knob (54 px)
- **DSP Usage:** `Decibels::decibelsToGain (db, -60.0f)` → exactly 0 at the floor; 20 ms `SmoothedValue` gain. Factory/lesson presets never set it.

## Non-Parameter State (not automatable)

| Key | Where | Notes |
|-----|-------|-------|
| `uiLanguage` | property on `parameters.state` | `"en"` / `"fr"` / `"zh-Hans"`; written in `getStateInformation` before the XML copy, restored only when present (older sessions stay English) |
| `IMPORTED_BANK` | child of the state tree | `version`, `filename`, `numFrames` (parse with `getIntValue()`), `encoding` = `flac16` (fallback `pcm16gz`), `data` = base64 (ARCHITECTURE §State Persistence) |

## Notes

- Parameters are implemented in EXACT order during Stage 1 (Foundation).
- Parameter IDs are snake_case and must remain consistent across all stages (they are the WebView relay names).
- No ID shadows a `juce::` free function; every Choice has ≥ 2 entries.
- UI controls are implemented from the v1 mockup during Stage 3 (GUI): `mockups/v1-ui.html`, `mockups/v1-i18n.js`, `mockups/v1-PluginEditor.{h,cpp}`, `mockups/v1-CMakeLists.txt`.
